en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4739 - Wahb ibn Wahb narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said that Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"The children of polytheists will be with their parents in the Fire, and the children of Muslims will be with their parents in Paradise."
